hypothesis: Downweight repeated question texts without choosing a supposedly correct target or changing original text.
question_grouping: Exact strings across all 60 original shards
exclusion: Every copy of the first 1024 held-out question texts
artifact: One uint32 count per original row; manifest with source and index SHA256
preflight: Compare 1024 batches from original and inverse-frequency streams; zero-power stream must remain identical. All target variants remain available.
selection: Only propose a bounded matched training pilot after verified index and reasonable CPU throughput. No accuracy claim or long training from this audit.
